scope: Native touch, metamagic and shared Protection coexistence checkpoint; final acceptance pending

checks.initialCompileFailure: Private native projectile distance field in diagnostics; replaced with public position properties before clean checks and runtime qualification.

fixtureFailures.cause: Native communal target preflight failed before casting. Initial faction/position setup did not establish the required isolated target set; the missing exact target diagnostic prevents a narrower cause claim. Revised fixture isolates owned actors on verified native walkable geometry and records the actual selector output.

The reused target did not produce a native missed touch in the bounded attempts. Its earlier control history prevents a clean hostile baseline; the exact reason for all hits was not proved. Replaced only the fixture target with a fresh native hostile actor and added actual attack, alignment/faction and auto-hit observations.

Fixture incorrectly expected a separate held command for Reach. Installed UnitUseAbility constructor converts Reach to direct delivery; fixed the helper to observe its actual command and advance only its native projectile. No production spell mechanics changed.

native.settings: All thirteen ON; shared control enhancement ON
native.profile: Installed all-loadable profile with Call of the Wild 1.14.4c-2.1

This is not real-time animation acceptance or hostile Reach accuracy qualification.
